Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Harpie's Pet Dragon
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Gains 300 ATK/DEF for each "Harpie Lady" on the field.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Metalmorph
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 300 ATK/DEF. If it attacks, it gains ATK equal to half the ATK of the attack target, during damage calculation only.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Red-Eyes Black Metal Dragon
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your Deck) by Tributing "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" equipped with "Metalmorph".
